subject: Re: CareFirst pilot - BAA scope & PHI routing questions
messages:
From: Dr. Lauren Miles <lauren.miles@carefirst.org>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: BAA scope for CareFirst pilot (PHI routing)

Hi Alex,

We're preparing the legal and security intake for a small pilot integrating CareFirst's mobile triage notes with a Redwood-powered summarization workflow. A couple of quick clarifications before we move to procurement: 

- Will Redwood be acting as a "processor" that will receive/store/transmit PHI for this flow, or can we keep PHI on our side and only send de-identified payloads?
- If PHI is processed, what deployment options are available for isolation (hosted with contractual BAA, dedicated/reserved capacity, or private VPC)?
- Do you have an existing DPIA summary showing whether Redwood's hosted model is acceptable for our EU/US mixed data (we're mainly US but have a small EU subset)?

If you could point me to a short dataflow diagram and any sample BAA language you use, that would help us scope procurement and our security review.

Thanks,
Lauren
Dr. Lauren Miles
Director, Clinical Integrations
CareFirst Health

P.S. Please include contacts for security & legal so we can loop them in early.

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lauren Miles <lauren.miles@carefirst.org>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: BAA scope for CareFirst pilot (PHI routing)

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front:

- Processor vs controller: Redwood will act as a processor when we take custody of PHI (we sign a BAA). We also support patterns where PHI never leaves your environment (Private deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed networking).
- Deployment options: Hosted with a signed BAA (our common path), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools with isolated tenancy), or Private (VPC / on-prem) for full separation. For a pilot we typically recommend Dedicated if you want low-friction onboarding with isolation guarantees.
- DPIA: I attached a one-page DPIA summary that covers typical PHI flows and mitigations. For mixed EU/US flows, we call out data residency and SCCs; we'll need to confirm specifics with your privacy team.

Attachments I've included: segmentation_matrix.xlsx (proposed logical segmentation for the pilot), redwood_dataflow_v2.pdf (annotated dataflow showing where PHI might be cached or stored), dpia-summary.docx (one-page DPIA). I'll also loop in Laura from legal for BAA language and procurement next steps.

Action items:
- Can you confirm whether the triage notes will be streamed directly from your EHR or batched via an intermediary?
- Please share the procurement contact (procurement@ is fine) and a preferred time for a 30-min tech + security sync.

Happy to hop on a call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales — Healthcare
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: segmentation_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), redwood_dataflow_v2.pdf (pdf), dpia-summary.docx (docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lauren Miles <lauren.miles@carefirst.org>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: BAA scope for CareFirst pilot (PHI routing) — sample language and evidence

Hi Lauren and team,

Thanks Alex. Laura on Redwood Legal here — looped in to move the BAA + procurement conversation forward. I reviewed Alex's attachments and attached a draft with our standard BAA redlines (redwood_baa_redlines.pdf). A few notes to speed review:

- High-level posture: Our hosted offering operates under our standard BAA for processor duties. Dedicated/Private deployments can be accommodated for customers who need stronger isolation or key custody.
- Logs & retention: We retain audit logs per contract; typical retention is 365 days by default with options for longer retention on Dedicated/Private. We can scope longer retention in the SOW.
- Key management: For hosted we use KMS with customer-managed keys available on Dedicated/Private. The dpia-summary includes our cryptography and key rotation practices.

We've made the BAA redlines narrow and annotated. Next steps from legal/procurement perspective:
1) Please provide a procurement POC and preferred DocuSign contact.
2) If you require SOC 2 Type II evidence, we can share a redacted report via a secure link (see related_links).
3) If CareFirst requires specific network segmentation diagrams, we can provide a network-level variant of the attached dataflow for Dedicated.

If helpful, I'd propose a 30-min call this week to walk legal/security through the draft redlines. Alex, can you propose times?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_baa_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Dr. Lauren Miles <lauren.miles@carefirst.org>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@carefirst.org>, security <security@carefirst.org>
Date: 2026-12-07T15:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: BAA scope for CareFirst pilot (PHI routing) — next steps

Alex/Laura — thanks for the quick follow-up and the docs. We reviewed the attachments and have a few follow-ups before we route to procurement:

1) Audit logs: Can you provide a sample audit-log export schema (fields and example rows) and confirm whether logs include tokenized request IDs and timestamped user IDs?
2) KMS / key custody: For hosted with BAA, where are keys stored and who controls rotation? If you offer a customer-managed-key option for Dedicated, can you outline the steps?
3) Data minimization: We prefer designs that avoid storing raw PHI where possible. Can you confirm whether your summarization path can be configured to:
   - only store aggregated outputs, and
   - purge raw inputs after processing (within X hours)?

Procurement POC is procurement@carefirst.org (you already have it). For SOC2 evidence, send the secure link and we'll route to our security team. Also proposing a 45-min deep-dive on Thursday (2026-12-09) at 10:00 AM ET to review the dataflow + BAA annotations — will that work?

Send over the sample log schema and a short KMS Q&A doc and we'll confirm the meeting.

Thanks,
Lauren
Dr. Lauren Miles
Director, Clinical Integrations
CareFirst Health
